WITH candidate AS ( SELECT run_id, state FROM agent_run_lifecycle.agent_runs WHERE workload_ordinal IS NOT NULL AND ( state IN ($4, $5) OR (state = $6 AND lease_until < clock_timestamp()) ) ORDER BY created_at, run_id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT $3 ) UPDATE agent_run_lifecycle.agent_runs a SET state = $7, claim_epoch = claim_epoch + $8, owner = $1, lease_until = clock_timestamp() + ($2::bigint * interval $9) FROM candidate WHERE a.run_id = candidate.run_id RETURNING a.run_id, a.parent_run_id, a.claim_epoch, a.principal_id, a.journey_kind, a.workload_ordinal, candidate.state

WITH location AS ( SELECT account_id, thread_id FROM agent_run_lifecycle.thread_events WHERE run_id = $1 AND event_type = $5 ), advanced AS ( UPDATE agent_run_lifecycle.threads thread SET next_sequence = thread.next_sequence + $6 FROM location WHERE thread.account_id = location.account_id AND thread.thread_id = location.thread_id RETURNING thread.account_id, thread.thread_id, thread.next_sequence - $7 AS sequence ), inserted_event AS ( INSERT INTO agent_run_lifecycle.thread_events (account_id, thread_id, sequence, event_id, event_type, content, run_id) SELECT account_id, thread_id, sequence, $3, $8, $4, $1 FROM advanced RETURNING account_id, thread_id, sequence, event_id ), interaction AS ( INSERT INTO agent_run_lifecycle.interaction_records (run_id, sequence, record_id, semantic_record) SELECT $1, COALESCE(max(sequence), $10) + $11, $3, $12 FROM agent_run_lifecycle.interaction_records WHERE run_id = $1 RETURNING run_id ), terminal AS ( UPDATE agent_run_lifecycle.agent_runs SET state = $14, owner = $15, lease_until = $16, terminal_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE run_id = $1 AND state = $17 AND claim_epoch = $2 AND EXISTS (SELECT $18 FROM interaction) RETURNING run_id ), notified AS ( SELECT pg_notify( $19, inserted_event.account_id || $20 || inserted_event.thread_id ) FROM inserted_event, terminal ) SELECT inserted_event.account_id, inserted_event.thread_id, inserted_event.sequence, inserted_event.event_id FROM inserted_event, terminal, notified

WITH location AS ( SELECT account_id, thread_id FROM agent_run_lifecycle.thread_events WHERE run_id = $1 AND event_type = $5 ), advanced AS ( UPDATE agent_run_lifecycle.threads thread SET next_sequence = thread.next_sequence + $6 FROM location WHERE thread.account_id = location.account_id AND thread.thread_id = location.thread_id RETURNING thread.account_id, thread.thread_id, thread.next_sequence - $7 AS sequence ), inserted_event AS ( INSERT INTO agent_run_lifecycle.thread_events (account_id, thread_id, sequence, event_id, event_type, content, run_id) SELECT account_id, thread_id, sequence, $3, $8, $4, $1 FROM advanced RETURNING account_id, thread_id, sequence, event_id ), interaction AS ( INSERT INTO agent_run_lifecycle.interaction_records (run_id, sequence, record_id, semantic_record) SELECT $1, COALESCE(max(sequence), $10) + $11, $3, $12 FROM agent_run_lifecycle.interaction_records WHERE run_id = $1 RETURNING run_id ), terminal AS ( UPDATE agent_run_lifecycle.agent_runs SET state = $14, owner = $15, lease_until = $16, terminal_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE run_id = $1 AND state = $17 AND claim_epoch = $2 AND EXISTS (SELECT $18 FROM interaction) RETURNING run_id ), notified AS ( SELECT pg_notify( $19, inserted_event.account_id || $20 || inserted_event.thread_id ) FROM inserted_event, terminal ) SELECT inserted_event.account_id, inserted_event.thread_id, inserted_event.sequence, inserted_event.event_id FROM inserted_event, terminal, notified
